duplicate_rule: same group when any of: same v1 group; pHash<=6 and dHash<=8; flip/rotation-invariant ResNet18 cosine>=0.92; ORB+RANSAC inliers>=30 with cosine>=0.85 (or inliers>=80 within a species)
session_rule: same session when the duplicate rule holds with cosine>=0.90 instead of 0.92; sessions with 30+ candidate photos are kept out of val/test; a val/test class takes at most 10 photos from one session
session_balance: the fabric/notebook tomato session has equal fresh and rotten counts in train (42/42) so its background cannot signal the label

leakage_audit.note: pairs above 0.91 were inspected by eye: different photos
